subject: MistralTech CAIQ calendar coordination & evidence dropbox
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Thomson <alex.thomson@mistraltech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MistralTech CAIQ calendar coordination & evidence dropbox

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking on the CAIQ review. To keep this light and actionable, I wanted to propose a short 45-minute slot to walk through your top-20 questions and confirm which artifacts we should expect in the evidence dropbox. Suggested windows (PST):

- Tue Jul 13 — 10:00–10:45
- Tue Jul 13 — 14:00–14:45
- Wed Jul 14 — 09:30–10:15

Agenda (30–45m):
1) Quick scope alignment (what sections you care most about)
2) Walk selected CAIQ questions and note owners for evidence
3) Evidence handoff logistics (dropbox path, naming, and retention)
4) Any blocking compliance asks (logs, KMS, SOC2 artifacts)

Pre-reads: we’ve attached a brief reference guide and a partial answers workbook where we’ve populated answers for the low-risk items to speed the call. Can you confirm which slot works and whether your security team will join? Also please flag any specific samples you need (e.g., last 90 days of key rotation logs, user provisioning CSV).

Attachments: redwood_caiq-reference-guide.pdf (PDF, 92KB); mistral_caiq_partial_answers.xlsx (XLSX, stub)

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Security Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0163

From: Alex Thomson <alex.thomson@mistraltech.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: security@mistraltech.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MistralTech CAIQ calendar coordination & evidence dropbox

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the materials. Tue Jul 13 14:00–14:45 PST works best for our security team (that’s 17:00–17:45 EST for us). I’ll invite our Security Ops lead (security@mistraltech.com).

Initial asks from our side before the call:
- We’ll want a sample of KMS key rotation logs for the past 90 days (redaction OK for user IDs).
- An example of an ingress/egress flow log for a typical customer request (one-hour window).
- Confirmation of where audit logs are stored and the retention policy (S3/GCS + lifecycle).

If you’ve already marked the low-risk answers in the workbook, that will speed things up — we’ll focus on the gaps.

Also: do you have a preferred dropbox for evidence (Drive vs S3 share)? For compliance we typically prefer a time-limited Drive folder.

Best,
Alex Thomson
Head of Security Integrations
MistralTech
alex.thomson@mistraltech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MistralTech CAIQ calendar coordination & evidence dropbox

Hi Alex and security team —

Confirmed: we’ve booked Tue Jul 13, 14:00–14:45 PST on the calendar. Calendar invite should be in your inbox from marissa.cole@redwood.com; please accept when you can.

Quick responses to the asks you raised:
- KMS/key rotation logs: we can provide a 90-day export. Those will come from our KMS audit bucket (S3). Redaction is fine; we’ll replace account emails with IDs. Owner: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com).
- Ingress/egress flow log sample: we’ll prepare a 1-hour capture from 2027-06-22 (typical load). Owner: Marissa Cole.
- Audit log storage & retention: primary storage is S3 (us-west-2), retention policy 365 days with an archived copy retained for 3 years; we’ll include the lifecycle policy document. Owner: Ben Carter.

Evidence staging: we’ll provision a time-limited Drive folder and share the link during/after the call. If you need S3 access instead, we can provide a pre-signed URL bundle.

Attachments uploaded to the folder will be named with this pattern: mistral_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>_<owner>.

I’ve also attached the partial answers workbook (we pre-populated ~60% of the CAIQ) to reduce call scope. 

Attachments referenced (uploaded): mistral_caiq_partial_answers.xlsx (XLSX, 180KB)

Action owners for the call:
- Agenda + runbook: Sofia Ivanova
- KMS logs & retention policy: Ben Carter
- Network flow sample: Marissa Cole

See you on Tue —
Marissa Cole
Security Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Thomson <alex.thomson@mistraltech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MistralTech CAIQ calendar coordination & evidence dropbox

Perfect — thanks Marissa/Sofia. We accepted the invite. A couple of small follow-ups before the call:

- Please include a copy of the most recent SOC 2 report (redacted is fine) if available; that will help our auditors triage a couple of control families quickly.
- For the KMS logs, ideally the export includes the key IDs and rotation timestamps. Redactions are fine for principal identifiers.

If you can upload the Drive link ahead of the call, we’ll do a quick pre-read and come with focused questions. Otherwise we’ll review live.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Alex
Head of Security Integrations
MistralTech
alex.thomson@mistraltech.com
